# A reading (a matched text and a first result) has one verdict when its lookups are one word; a homograph has the verdict split, and its lookups follow as <set>-lookup rows (n = reading.lookup), each judged from its own context.

# dictionary alone: the first result of the same lookup with no rules; its verdict and the form-of tie are given for replaced only. form-of tie: yes when a form-of row of the text also names the rules' first result, so that the dictionary names both terms and their order is discovery order.
